title: Poussette Chain (?)
author: Moose Flores
problems: Row 8 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 8 "partners swing" doesn't work out: Couple 2 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 1 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 2 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 3 "right left through" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
Row 4 "circle right 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 7 "right diagonal robins chain to shadow" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
